metadata.title: Cookie and Local Storage Policy
metadata.description: Information about cookies and local storage in Kiso Desk.

definition.title: 1. What are cookies and local storage?
definition.paragraph1: This application uses cookies and browser local storage for necessary service functions and to remember certain usage preferences.
definition.paragraph2: Cookies are small text files that websites store in your browser. They are used to remember information about your visit, such as your preferences or authentication status.
definition.paragraph3: Local storage, also known as localStorage, is a browser feature that allows data to be stored directly on your device. Unlike cookies, this data is not automatically sent to the server with every request and remains on your device until you, your browser, or your device settings delete it.

data.title: 2. Personal and technical data linked to these technologies
data.paragraph1: To provide the typing service, the application may process personal or technical data linked to the use of cookies, local storage, and network requests.
data.paragraph2: Metrics associated with registered accounts are stored by the service as described in the Privacy Notice. In guest mode, some progress and practice history may be stored locally in the browser.
data.paragraph3: Local storage may contain interface preferences, the decision regarding non-essential technologies, and guest progress. It does not directly contain passwords or authentication tokens.
data.item1: Session identifiers: stored in the access_token and refresh_token cookies, which allow the application to recognize your account, authenticate requests, and keep your session active.
data.item2: IP address and technical connection data: transmitted when interacting with the server and when loading external resources, such as flag images from flagcdn.com.
data.item3: Preferences and local data: may include the theme, keyboard layout, font, text size, keyboard visibility, decision regarding non-essential technologies, guest progress, and local history of texts used.

necessaryCookies.title: 3. Strictly necessary cookies (authentication)
necessaryCookies.paragraph1: The application uses strictly necessary cookies to sign you in, maintain your identity while browsing, renew your session, and protect authenticated requests.
necessaryCookies.note: These cookies are not used for advertising, remarketing, or commercial profiling.
necessaryCookies.accessTokenPurpose: Authenticate your requests and keep the access session active.
necessaryCookies.refreshTokenPurpose: Securely renew the session and allow it to be revoked.

localStorage.title: 4. Local storage (user preferences)
localStorage.paragraph1: To personalize the experience and retain certain settings, the application stores information in the browser.
localStorage.paragraph2: This data remains on the device and is not automatically sent to the server with every request, although the application may read it to apply preferences or restore local progress.
localStorage.themePurpose: Remember your preference between light and dark mode.
localStorage.themeDuration: Persistent until manually deleted or overwritten.
localStorage.keyboardLayoutPurpose: Remember the keyboard layout selected for exercises.
localStorage.typingFontPurpose: Remember the font family used in exercises.
localStorage.typingFontSizePurpose: Remember the text size configured for exercises.

providers.title: 5. External providers, processors, and possible transfers
providers.paragraph1: The application uses or may use external providers for necessary service functions, such as infrastructure, authentication, security, and resource delivery. Integrations prepared for future functions are not considered active until they are configured and placed into operation.
providers.paragraph2: When a provider processes personal data on behalf of Kiso Desk and under its instructions, it will act as a processor or service provider, as applicable.
providers.paragraph3: Kiso Desk uses Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to host and operate technical components of the service. Data processed in that infrastructure is used to maintain accounts, preserve progress, and operate the platform.
providers.paragraph4: The application allows users to sign in with Google. In that flow, Kiso Desk receives only the authorized data necessary to authenticate the account, such as the Google identifier, email address, verification status, and profile name.
providers.paragraph5: The application uses flagcdn.com to load flag images. When those resources are requested, the provider may receive customary technical data, such as the IP address, user agent, date, time, and referrer URL.
providers.paragraph6: When data is disclosed or transferred to a third party other than a processor, it will be handled in accordance with applicable law, including cases necessary to provide the service, maintain the relationship with the user, protect rights, or comply with legal obligations.
providers.paragraph7: Cloudflare Turnstile may be used conditionally to prevent bots and abuse, which may involve Cloudflare processing technical connection data. Email-based recovery is prepared but is not active until an email provider is configured. Analytics cookies, advertising networks, remarketing, and other non-essential tracking systems are not currently used.

legalBasis.title: 6. Legal basis and privacy principles
legalBasis.paragraph1: Processing associated with strictly necessary cookies is carried out to sign users in, keep sessions active, authenticate requests, and protect account operation.
legalBasis.paragraph2: Kiso Desk processes data in accordance with applicable law. When information is necessary to provide the requested service or fulfill obligations arising from the relationship with the user, additional consent will not be requested unless required by applicable law.
legalBasis.paragraph3: Kiso Desk also uses internationally recognized privacy principles as a reference, including transparency, purpose specification, data minimization, accuracy, limited retention, security, user control, and accountability. This reference does not constitute certification or a statement of full compliance with foreign laws that do not apply.
legalBasis.paragraph4: If non-essential technologies such as analytics, advertising, remarketing, or other tracking mechanisms are introduced in the future, this Policy will be updated and the corresponding consent will be requested before activation when necessary.

arco.title: 7. Data rights and withdrawal of consent
arco.paragraph1: You may request access to, correction, deletion, or objection regarding personal data associated with your account, and you may withdraw consent for processing activities that require it, where applicable.
arco.paragraph2: To exercise these rights, you may send a request to: kisodesk.project@gmail.com.
arco.paragraph3: The controller will communicate its decision within the applicable legal period and, when the request is granted, will implement it within the corresponding period.
arco.paragraph4: These periods may be extended when permitted by applicable law and justified by the circumstances.
arco.paragraph5: Withdrawal of consent will not affect processing previously carried out or processing that must continue because of a legal obligation, an ongoing relationship, security, the defense of rights, or necessary retention.
arco.item1: The alias or account identifier used in the application, if applicable.
arco.item2: The email address associated with your account.
arco.item4: Reasonable information to verify your identity or ownership of the account, preferably through the associated email address. If acting through a representative, documentation proving their authority.
arco.item5: The right you wish to exercise: access, correction, deletion, objection, or withdrawal of consent.
arco.item6: A clear and precise description of the personal data involved in your request, such as the email address, alias, preferences, or typing metrics associated with the account.
arco.item7: For correction requests, the correct information and, where necessary, supporting information for the requested correction.
arco.item8: Any other information reasonably necessary to identify your account and properly address your request.

management.title: 8. How to manage and delete this data
management.paragraph1: You can manage cookies, local storage, and your decision regarding non-essential technologies.
management.item1: Sign out: when you sign out, the access_token and refresh_token authentication cookies are deleted from the browser.
management.item2: Privacy and cookie preferences: you can review and change your decision regarding non-essential technologies from your profile. You can also delete cookies and local data through your browser settings.
management.item3: Warning: blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent you from signing in or using functions that require authentication.

changes.title: 9. Changes to this Policy
changes.paragraph1: The application may update this Policy to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes. Updates will be published on this page with the corresponding last-updated date.
changes.paragraph2: When changes are relevant, they will be communicated through a visible notice in the application, a cookie notice, or another available electronic method.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.paragraph1: If you have questions, wish to exercise your rights, or need information about data processing, you may write to kisodesk.project@gmail.com.
contact.paragraph2: To review the identity and contact information of the controller, general purposes, providers, retention, and other processing details, see the application's Privacy Notice.

general.title: Privacy Notice
general.description: Information about personal data processing under applicable law and internationally recognized privacy principles.
general.introduction: This Notice explains what information Kiso Desk processes, how it is used, with whom it may be shared, and what controls users have. Reference to international principles does not constitute certification or a statement of full compliance with foreign laws that do not apply.

data.title: 1. Data we process
data.sensitiveNote: Kiso Desk does not request sensitive personal data. Accessibility or interface preferences are used only as functional application settings and are not intended to collect information about health, disability, ethnic origin, religion, political opinions, sexual orientation, or other sensitive data.
data.item1: Account: email address, profile name when applicable, alias selected by the user, role, language, keyboard layout, and accessibility preferences.
data.item2: Authentication: a password stored as a hash when the account is created with a password, or the data necessary to sign in with Google when that method is used.
data.item3: Learning: courses, lessons, progress, speed, accuracy, practice time, errors, keys used, and events necessary to calculate typing metrics.
data.item4: Social features: friendships, requests, blocks, presence, last connection, and shared statistics according to the available preferences.
data.item5: Ranking: alias, speed, accuracy, level, practice language, position, and result date when applicable.
data.item6: Technical data: IP address, user agent, logs, session identifiers, diagnostic data, and technical requests generated by the infrastructure or providers used.
data.item7: Local data: theme, keyboard layout, font, text size, keyboard visibility, decision regarding non-essential technologies, guest progress, and local text history.

purposes.title: 2. How we use the data
purposes.item1: Create and manage accounts and sessions.
purposes.item2: Allow sign-in with a password or Google, depending on the method selected.
purposes.item3: Provide lessons, save progress, and generate typing statistics.
purposes.item4: Customize the keyboard layout, interface, font, text size, and other usage preferences.
purposes.item5: Display general rankings and rankings by language.
purposes.item6: Operate social features, including friendships, presence, last connection, and statistics visible according to account preferences.
purposes.item7: Protect accounts, prevent abuse, detect unauthorized activity, and diagnose errors.
purposes.item8: Allow data downloads and account deletion from the profile.
purposes.item9: Respond to support, privacy, and security requests.
purposes.item10: Comply with legal obligations and defend claims.
purposes.item11: If Google AdSense is activated in the future, display and measure advertising, prevent fraud, and, where applicable, personalize ads with the information and consent required by applicable law.

legalBasis.title: 3. Basis and principles of processing
legalBasis.paragraph1: Processing is carried out primarily to provide the requested service, manage accounts, maintain sessions, save progress, generate statistics, operate rankings and social features, allow data downloads or deletion, and protect the platform.
legalBasis.paragraph2: Kiso Desk processes data in accordance with applicable law. When information is necessary to provide the service or fulfill obligations arising from the relationship with the user, additional consent will not be requested unless required by applicable law.
legalBasis.paragraph3: Kiso Desk also uses internationally recognized privacy principles as a reference, including transparency, purpose specification, data minimization, accuracy, limited retention, security, user control, and accountability. This reference does not constitute certification or a statement of full compliance with foreign laws that do not apply.
legalBasis.paragraph4: For purposes that require consent, consent will be requested where appropriate and may be withdrawn without retroactive effect. If new purposes are added that are different from or unnecessary to provide the service, this Notice will be updated before the new processing begins when required.

recipients.title: 4. Providers and recipients
recipients.paragraph1: Kiso Desk uses technology providers to operate infrastructure, hosting, authentication, resource delivery, and security. The email integration is prepared but is not active until a provider is configured.
recipients.paragraph2: When these providers process personal data on behalf of Kiso Desk and under its instructions, they will act as processors or service providers and will use the information only to provide the contracted functions.
recipients.paragraph3: Google Cloud Platform hosts and operates technical components of the service. Google also acts as an authentication provider when the user chooses to sign in with a Google account.
recipients.paragraph4: The application loads flag images from flagcdn.com. When those resources are requested, the provider may receive customary technical data, such as the IP address, user agent, date, time, and referrer URL.
recipients.paragraph5: Cloudflare Turnstile may be used conditionally to prevent bots and abuse. When activated, Cloudflare may receive technical connection data necessary to verify the request. Google AdSense and advertising are not active; before they are enabled, the information will be updated and the necessary controls will be applied.
recipients.paragraph6: The data subject may object to disclosures or transfers that require consent by using the privacy email address. This objection will not affect disclosures or transfers necessary to provide the service, maintain the relationship with the user, protect rights, prevent abuse, or comply with legal obligations.

transfers.title: 5. Transfers and processing in other jurisdictions
transfers.paragraph1: Kiso Desk may use technology providers located in different jurisdictions to host, operate, protect, and maintain the service.
transfers.paragraph2: When those providers act as processors, they will process data on behalf of Kiso Desk and in accordance with the relevant instructions and purposes.
transfers.paragraph3: When data is disclosed or transferred to a third party other than a processor, it will be handled under the circumstances permitted by applicable law, including cases necessary to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, protect rights, or where consent exists.
transfers.paragraph4: The use of Google Cloud Platform, Google OAuth, Cloudflare Turnstile when active, and flagcdn.com may involve processing technical or account data in other jurisdictions, according to the service configuration and each provider's applicable policies.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.item1: The access_token cookie has a maximum duration of 2 hours, and the refresh_token cookie has a maximum duration of 7 days.
retention.item2: Account and progress data is retained while the account remains active or while necessary to provide the service, operate rankings and social features, comply with legal obligations, address requests, prevent abuse, resolve incidents, or defend rights.
retention.item3: Ranking and social-feature data is retained while the account is active or while necessary to operate those functions, unless the user changes their preferences, deletes the account, or exercises an applicable right.
retention.item4: Local backups generated during deployments are retained for up to 30 days. Technical logs are rotated by size and kept for as long as necessary to operate, protect, and diagnose the service.
retention.item5: When personal data is no longer necessary, it will be deleted, anonymized, or blocked before deletion, as applicable, unless it must be retained because of an applicable obligation.

rights.title: 7. Rights and requests
rights.paragraph1: You may request access to, correction, deletion, or objection regarding your personal data, and you may withdraw consent for processing activities that require it, where applicable.
rights.paragraph2: From the profile, the application allows you to download a structured copy of the data associated with the account and request its deletion through the available mechanisms.
rights.paragraph3: Users can limit the disclosure of data visible in rankings or social features, review or change the decision regarding non-essential technologies, and block other users through the application's controls.
rights.paragraph4: You may also submit requests related to privacy, limitation of data use or disclosure, and the exercise of rights through the email address listed in this Notice.

children.title: 8. Minors
children.paragraph1: The service is not directed to minors.
children.paragraph2: To create an account and use the service independently, a person must have reached the legal age of majority under the law applicable in their place of residence.
children.paragraph3: If Kiso Desk detects that an account belongs to a minor, it may limit unnecessary processing and evaluate suspension, deletion, blocking, or regularization of the account in accordance with applicable law and the protection of the person's rights.

security.title: 9. Security
security.paragraph1: Kiso Desk applies administrative, technical, and physical measures intended to protect personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction, unauthorized use, access, or processing.
security.paragraph2: These measures may include access controls, authentication, secure password storage, protected session management, HttpOnly cookies, abuse prevention, technical logs, internal restrictions, and other measures proportionate to the risk and technological development.
security.paragraph3: No system is infallible. If an incident significantly affects users' rights, Kiso Desk will make the communications and take the actions required under applicable law.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this Privacy Notice
changes.paragraph1: This Notice may be updated to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes.
changes.paragraph2: Updates will be published on this page with the corresponding last-updated date.
changes.paragraph3: When a change is relevant, it will be communicated through a visible notice in the application or another available electronic method.
changes.paragraph4: If a new purpose requires consent, the corresponding processing will not begin until consent is obtained when required by applicable law.

general.introduction: These terms govern access to the application, accounts, learning features, and available social features.

service.title: 1. Service description
service.paragraph1: Kiso Desk provides typing lessons and practice, progress tracking, statistics, rankings, and social features related to learning and practicing keyboard typing.
service.paragraph2: By creating an account, signing in, or using the service, you agree to these Terms of Use.
service.paragraph3: Features may change, be updated, limited, or discontinued during the development and operation of the service, always in accordance with applicable law and without affecting non-waivable rights.

eligibility.title: 2. Age and eligibility
eligibility.paragraph1: To create an account and use the service independently, you must have reached the legal age of majority under the law applicable in your place of residence.
eligibility.paragraph2: If applicable law requires additional capacity, authorization, or age requirements, you must meet them before using the service.
eligibility.paragraph3: The service is not directed to minors. If you are a minor under applicable law, you must not create an account or provide personal data on your own.

account.title: 3. Account and security

account.item2: You are responsible for protecting your credentials or access methods and for signing out on shared devices.
account.item3: You must not assign, sell, transfer, or use another person's account.
account.item4: You must report any unauthorized access or security incident through the contact channel listed in these Terms.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: By using the service, you agree to follow these rules:
acceptableUse.item1: Do not interfere with the security, availability, or operation of the service.
acceptableUse.item2: Do not extract data, automate requests, scrape, overload the infrastructure, or bypass technical limits without authorization.
acceptableUse.item3: Do not harass, impersonate, deceive, or attempt to obtain information from other users.
acceptableUse.item4: Do not upload, reproduce, distribute, or use content without sufficient rights to do so.
acceptableUse.item5: Do not use the service for illegal, abusive, fraudulent, harmful activities or activities contrary to these Terms.

social.title: 5. Rankings and social features
social.paragraph1: The service includes rankings, profiles, and other social features.
social.paragraph2: These features may display an alias, speed, accuracy, level, progress, online status, last activity, or typing statistics according to the available preferences.
social.paragraph3: When an account is created, certain social features are enabled by default. You can disable them individually from your profile. Your real name and email address are not published, and presence or shared statistics are shown only to accepted friends as described in the Privacy Notice.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.paragraph1: The software, design, interface, text, exercises, images, audio, trademarks, logos, and other elements of the service belong to their respective owners.
intellectualProperty.paragraph2: Access to the service does not transfer intellectual property rights in the application or its content.
intellectualProperty.paragraph3: Content available through the service may only be used to practice typing and use the application's features, unless expressly authorized or subject to a different license.

availability.title: 7. Availability and changes
availability.paragraph1: The service may be interrupted, limited, or modified because of maintenance, updates, security, technical failures, operational changes, or causes beyond Kiso Desk's reasonable control.
availability.paragraph2: Relevant changes will be communicated when reasonably possible.
availability.paragraph3: Kiso Desk does not guarantee any specific improvement in speed, accuracy, academic performance, job performance, employability, or any other particular result from using the service.

suspension.title: 8. Suspension and termination
suspension.paragraph1: Kiso Desk may limit, suspend, or terminate an account when there is a violation of these Terms, abuse of the service, a security risk, unauthorized use, harm to other users, or illegal or harmful activity.
suspension.paragraph2: When reasonable, the user may request a review of the measure through the contact channel listed in these Terms.
suspension.paragraph3: Termination, suspension, or limitation of an account does not affect obligations or liabilities arising before the measure.
suspension.paragraph4: Deletion or retention of personal data associated with the account will be handled in accordance with the Privacy Notice and applicable law.

liability.title: 9. Liability
liability.paragraph1: The service is provided according to its current availability and operation.
liability.paragraph2: Nothing in these Terms limits non-waivable rights granted to users under applicable law or excludes liabilities that cannot legally be limited.
liability.paragraph3: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Kiso Desk will not be liable for indirect damages, interruptions, data loss, or harm resulting from causes beyond its reasonable control, misuse of the account, false or outdated information, failures by third parties outside the service, or the user's violation of these Terms.
liability.paragraph4: The foregoing does not exclude liability for a legal violation attributable to Kiso Desk, willful misconduct, bad faith, gross negligence, infringement of non-waivable rights, failure to meet security obligations, or improper processing of personal data.

law.title: 10. Applicable law and contact
law.paragraph1: These Terms will be governed by and interpreted under the law applicable to the service controller, without prejudice to any non-waivable rights users may have under the law applicable in their place of residence.
law.paragraph2: Nothing in these Terms limits the user's right to contact competent consumer protection, data protection, or other applicable authorities.

general.title: About Kiso Desk
general.subtitle: A platform for practicing typing in a clear, consistent, and measurable way
general.project_text: Kiso Desk is an independent project focused on creating a clear and practical experience for learning how to type.
general.project_status_text: It is designed as a space where anyone, regardless of their experience level, can practice consistently and see real improvement. The focus is on continuous learning, practicality, and attention to detail, providing a useful tool for today's needs.
general.mission_text: At Kiso Desk, we believe typing is an essential skill in the digital world. Our mission is to make learning to type quickly and accurately accessible, practical, and effective for everyone, regardless of their experience level.
general.vision_text: To build a useful tool for improving typing speed, accuracy, and confidence, with a modern, clear experience focused on consistent practice.
general.history_text: Kiso Desk began as an independent project to create a modern typing practice experience. What started as a simple idea is now evolving into a platform focused on lessons, progress, statistics, and continuous improvement.
